verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a hands-on community report of an employee exercising options for about $20k through Carta, with Carta initiating the bank-transfer payment. That shows an online exercise and payment flow exists, but the same report describes the transfer failing and exercise rights being canceled with no retry, and nothing documents the flow first-party. The FMV API only calculates the tax implications of exercising, which is adjacent rather than the exercise flow itself. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the online exercise workflow, evidence of payment-method options, evidence of resulting share issuance or certificates, confirmation that no paper forms are needed, reliable payment handling.

support.subject: As an employee, I can exercise my vested options online — including payment and the resulting share issuance — without paper forms

citations.quote: After leaving my company I exercised options for ~$20k; six months later Carta attempted a single bank transfer
